Title: Separate token types and accept only access tokens on API endpoints
What & why: Challenge and purpose tokens (mfa_pending, mfa_setup_required) are accepted as bearer tokens, so a PIN alone can bypass MFA. Add typ/aud claims and make the resource server accept only typ=access.
Source refs: MF-01; EP01; ADR-08 prerequisite | Src: ARCH-01, SEC-01, QA-01 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: A first-factor token gets 401 on every authenticated endpoint; challenge tokens decode only at their own endpoint; every non-public endpoint requires a sid or authority; TokenMisuseMatrixTest green.

Title: Gate break-glass behind a permission, step-up and owner notification
What & why: Any staff member can self-activate break-glass and get full Owner rights, and anyone can deactivate anyone's grant. Restrict it to eligible roles, require step-up MFA, notify the owner and limit it to a clinical-read emergency scope.
Source refs: MF-02; EP01; PS-08; Quick win #11 (@PreAuthorize on deactivate) | Src: SEC-02, SEC-36, ARCH-18, QA-02, QA-03, QA-26 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Receptionist activation returns 403 (BreakGlassAuthzTest); owner notified < 60 s; break-glass token carries clinical-read scope only; deactivate restricted to self or Owner; auto-expires at 30 min (J14).
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Forbid self-delegation and compute grantor rights from the base role
What & why: Staff can delegate Owner rights to themselves for 30 days, and delegated or break-glass rights count as grantor rights. Block both and revoke elevated sessions.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: DelegationEscalationTest (self, chained, via break-glass) returns 403; grantor rights computed from base role only; elevated sessions revoked on change.

Title: Add TOTP and unlock attempt limits and require longer PINs
What & why: TOTP has no attempt limit and /auth/unlock is an unthrottled PIN oracle with 4-6 digit PINs. Add per-account counters sharing the login lockout, a 6+ digit PIN and a passphrase for Owner/operator.
Source refs: MF-09 | Src: SEC-05, QA-27, SEC-21 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: TotpLockoutTest and UnlockBruteForceTest green; counters share the account lockout; PIN length >= 6; Owner/operator require a passphrase.

Title: Trust X-Forwarded-For only from known proxy hops
What & why: Client IP is read blindly from X-Forwarded-For, allowing rate-limit bypass, forged audit IPs and 500s on bad values. Use native forward-headers strategy with a trusted-proxy list and validate the IP.
Source refs: MF-10; Quick win #2 | Src: ARCH-08, SEC-07 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: XffSpoofTest green: spoofed header ignored for rate limit and audit IP; malformed value never causes a 500.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day).

Title: Stop logging OTPs, reset tokens and free-text PHI
What & why: OTP codes, PIN-reset tokens, phone numbers and free-text reasons are written to logs by default. Default log-otp to false, refuse to boot in prod with it on, and log reason codes only through a masking converter.
Source refs: MF-14; Quick win #1; ADR-14 | Src: ARCH-09, ARCH-28, SEC-12 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Log-capture test proves no OTP/phone/reason text is logged; app fails to start in prod profile if log-otp=true; Logback masking converter active; CI log-PHI scan added.
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Persist the JWT signing key in a secret manager and publish JWKS
What & why: The JWT key pair is regenerated on every boot, so deploys log everyone out and two replicas cannot share sessions. Load keys from KMS/secret manager, publish JWKS with two active kids, and validate iss/aud/typ.
Source refs: MF-13; EP01 | Src: ARCH-03, SEC-26, QA-37 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Restart/refresh test across two replicas passes (QA-37); JWKS exposes 2 active kids; tokens with wrong iss/aud/typ rejected; a rolling restart logs nobody out.

Title: Allow PUT in CORS so pregnancy status and "no known allergies" can be saved
What & why: CORS forbids PUT, so the UI silently fails to record pregnancy status or "no known allergies" and safety rules cannot fire. Add PUT and a preflight contract test.
Source refs: MF-49; EP05; Quick win #3 | Src: QA-05 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: CorsPreflightTest green for PUT; E2E J7 (pregnancy from the UI escalates a teratogen line) green.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day). The BFF (MF-15) later makes this same-origin.

Title: Decode JWT claims with TextDecoder so non-Latin names render correctly
What & why: atob corrupts Arabic and Devanagari staff and clinic names (mojibake) in 5 copies of the claim decoder. Replace with one UTF-8 safe helper.
Source refs: MF-57 (FE-04 part); EP24; Quick win #8 | Src: FE-04, FE-05, FE-30 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Unit test decodes Arabic, Hindi, Kannada and Telugu names correctly; a single helper replaces all 5 copies.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day).

Title: Contain brand-visibility RLS widening and switch to the indexable array policy
What & why: OR-shaped brand-visibility policies widen reads without consent, allow sibling writes (no WITH CHECK) and cause 933 ms scans inside the check-in lock. Apply CONS M0/M1 containment and the ADR-07 array policy.
Source refs: MF-04 (containment); ADR-07; CONS §7 M0/M1 | Src: SEC-04, DP-02, ARCH-37, CONS §7 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: WITH CHECK (single tenant) on every widened policy; legacy-brand-visibility flag off by default; no widening on staff/sessions/roles; tenant_id predicate added to nextTokenNumber, countSessionOccupancy and registry subqueries; EXPLAIN plan-regression test shows nextTokenNumber ~1 ms (was 933 ms).

Title: Split database roles: migrator owner, NOBYPASSRLS runtime role, FORCE RLS and a boot self-check
What & why: The app role runs Flyway and owns every table, so RLS is inert in deployment. Create nabd_migrator (owner) and nabd_app (DML only, NOBYPASSRLS), force RLS on every tenant table and fail boot if the invariant is broken.
Source refs: MF-03; EP02; ADR-07 | Src: ARCH-02, SEC-03 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: RlsSchemaInvariantTest over pg_class/pg_policies green; app refuses to start if runtime role owns an RLS table, has BYPASSRLS, or a tenant_id table lacks forced RLS; dev-up.sh rewritten for split roles; prod-config CI job green.

Title: Add missing patient-path indexes concurrently and drop duplicate indexes
What & why: Patient-scoped visit reads do 2.5 s sequential scans and the audit chain head lookup takes 5 s. Add the patient, vitals, audit_log, appointment and invoice indexes CONCURRENTLY and drop the 4 redundant ones.
Source refs: MF-06; MF-31 (index part); EP03; Quick win #6 | Src: DP-01, DP-24, DP-25, ARCH-07, DP-05, SEC-27 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: queue_entries(tenant_id, patient_id, queue_date DESC), vitals partial, audit_log(tenant_id, id DESC), appointments(tenant_id, start_time), invoices partial created CONCURRENTLY; 4 duplicates dropped; patient timeline < 5 ms (was 2,485 ms); EXPLAIN regression tests in CI.
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Write the migration playbook and add a CI migration lint
What & why: Migrations use non-concurrent indexes, CHECKs without NOT VALID, in-transaction backfills and have version gaps, which break rolling deploys. Document expand/contract rules and enforce them in CI.
Source refs: MF-45; ADR-15 | Src: DP-12, ARCH-35 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Playbook committed in docs/; CI lint fails on non-CONCURRENTLY index, missing lock_timeout, CHECK without NOT VALID, non-monotonic versions; flyway validate runs in CI.

Title: Upgrade Next.js to 16.4.2 or later and add dependency scanning and SBOM
What & why: next@16.3.1 is in a critical advisory range (RCE, cache poisoning, SSRF) and there is no SCA or SBOM. Upgrade and add Renovate, npm audit/Trivy/Dependency-Check gates and a CycloneDX SBOM.
Source refs: MF-05; Quick win #4 | Src: FE-03, SEC-31 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: npm audit shows 0 critical; Renovate configured; npm audit --audit-level=high and Trivy/Dependency-Check run in CI; CycloneDX SBOM produced per build.
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Add single-flight token refresh and returnTo to the clinic app
What & why: The clinic app never refreshes its 15-minute token, so every 401 bounces staff to /login and they lose half-written notes. Port the platform refresh logic into one client with returnTo.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: 8 h shift simulation with 0 forced logouts; concurrent 401s trigger exactly one refresh; after re-login user returns to the same page.

Title: Pause polling in hidden tabs and add sequence guards to live screens
What & why: Arrivals, Nursing and My Day poll every 15 s even in hidden tabs, and stale responses overwrite fresh ones. Interim fix until SSE (EP06) lands.
Source refs: MF-41 (interim); Quick win #9 | Src: DP-04, FE-08, FE-09, FE-10 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: No API requests while the tab is hidden; out-of-order responses discarded in Nursing, My Day and Arrivals (race test).
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Pin Testcontainers 1.21+, run next typegen before tsc and wire the consult-flow test
What & why: Testcontainers 1.19.8 fails on Docker 29 (459/560 tests error), tsc fails on a fresh checkout, and the consult-flow test is not wired.
Source refs: MF-35 (QA-34, FE-29); Quick win #5 | Src: QA-36, QA-34, SEC-30, FE-29 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: mvn test passes on Docker Engine 29 without overrides; next typegen && tsc --noEmit passes on a fresh checkout; test-consult-flow.mjs runs in npm test.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day each).

Title: Create the GitHub Actions pipeline (static, unit, integration) and make CI block merges
What & why: There is no CI and the image is built with -DskipTests, so no fix is protected. Build stages 1-3 of the pipeline with path filters and branch protection. Audit: repository and code-review policy (old NB-297).
Source refs: MF-35 (QA-36, SEC-30); EP03; ADR-15; doc06 §7.1; Audit 17 Oct 2026: Old plan: NB-297 | Src: QA-36, QA-34, SEC-30, FE-29 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Stages 1 Static (<= 3 min), 2 Unit (<= 2 min), 3 Integration (<= 6 min) run on every PR; main is protected and merges are blocked on red; image no longer built with -DskipTests. Branch protection on main, required review (CODEOWNERS for clinical and security paths), signed commits, no direct pushes.
Notes: Scope extended by the requirements audit 17 Oct 2026.

Title: Write the token-misuse matrix test suite
What & why: First suite to add (doc06 §7.4): every token type against every endpoint must return 401 unless it is the token's own endpoint. It guards MF-01 permanently.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: TokenMisuseMatrixTest enumerates all controllers via reflection and runs in stage 3; any new endpoint is covered automatically.

Title: Add the prod-config CI job (Flyway as migrator, app as nabd_app)
What & why: Tests run as the table owner, which hides RLS gaps. Add a job that boots the app exactly as production does and runs the suite.
Source refs: MF-03; MF-36; ADR-07 | Src: ARCH-02, SEC-03, SEC-23, FE-15 | doc06 §6.2
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Job migrates as nabd_migrator, runs the API suite as nabd_app and is a required check.

Title: Appoint the Clinical Safety Officer and start hazard log v0
What & why: Clinical-safety work (dictionary, signing rules, release sign-off) needs a named CSO and a hazard log before the pilot. Governance gate listed in the Sprint 0 QA/CI track.
Source refs: EP05; RM D10; doc06 D10 | doc06 §6.2 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: CSO hired or contracted; hazard log v0 created with one entry per [CLIN-SAFETY] finding; fortnightly clinical safety review scheduled.
Notes: Non-code governance item; owner Founder/CTO. Required for the Phase 0 exit gate.

Title: Set role-level DB timeouts and explicit Hikari pool settings
What & why: There are no statement, lock or idle-in-transaction timeouts and Hikari runs at the default 10 connections. Quick win ahead of the full MF-32 fix.
Source refs: MF-32; Quick win #7; ADR-07 | Src: ARCH-10, DP-06, DP-09 | doc06 §6.6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: nabd_app has statement_timeout=5s, lock_timeout=3s, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=15s; nabd_reports 60 s; Hikari pool 15-20 with 3 s connection timeout.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day). Suggested sprint: S0.

Title: Cap delay minutes and reject check-in on the wrong day
What & why: Delay minutes are unbounded and an appointment can be checked in on any day. Add @Max on delay input and a date check at check-in.
Source refs: MF-42; MF-29; Quick win #12 | Src: QA-06, QA-07, QA-08, DP-08, QA-23 | doc06 §6.6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Delay > max returns 400; check-in for an appointment not dated today (clinic timezone) returns 409.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day). Suggested sprint: S0.

Title: Use Locale.ROOT in RxSafetyChecks matching
What & why: Drug and allergy matching lowercases with the default locale, which breaks on Turkish-style locales and is non-deterministic across servers.
Source refs: MF-51; Quick win #13 | Src: QA-16 | doc06 §6.6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Matching uses Locale.ROOT; unit test runs under tr-TR and ar-SA default locales.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day). Suggested sprint: S0.

Title: Relabel the package "Send reminder" button to "Mark reminded"
What & why: The button records a WhatsApp send that never happens (fake "sent" state). Relabel it until EP07 wires real sending.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Button reads "Mark reminded"; no UI text claims a message was sent.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day). Suggested sprint: S0.

Title: Fix the tertiary text contrast token
What & why: --nb-text-tertiary is 4.0:1 on surface-3 (fails WCAG AA) across 169 rules.
Source refs: MF-76 (FE-22); Quick win #17 | Src: FE-20, FE-21, FE-22 | doc06 §6.6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Token meets >= 4.5:1 on all surfaces; minimum 12 px text.
Notes: Quick win (< 1 day). Suggested sprint: S0.

Title: Require the current factor for MFA re-enrolment and wire recovery codes
What & why: MFA re-enrolment overwrites the active secret without proof, recovery codes accumulate and are never consumed, and there is no admin reset.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Old secret keeps working until the new one is confirmed (pending-secret column); re-enrol requires current TOTP or step-up; recovery codes rotate and are consumed once; audited admin reset exists.

Title: Block role assignment beyond the caller's own grants, audit it and revoke sessions
What & why: Staff role assignment and invite accept any roleId including Owner, are unaudited and do not revoke sessions.
Source refs: MF-11; EP01; AD-02 | Src: SEC-08 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Escalation test returns 403 when assigned grants exceed caller grants; audit row on every role change; target's sessions revoked.

Title: Harden the idle lock and clear consult drafts on sign-out
What & why: The idle lock is bypassed by reload or a new tab, the page behind it is not inert, and plaintext consult drafts (PHI) survive sign-out on shared workstations.
Source refs: MF-59; Quick win #10 | Src: FE-12, FE-17 | doc06 §6.3
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Lock state persists across reload and broadcasts to all tabs; content behind lock is inert; expiry shows a distinct message (not "Incorrect PIN"); IndexedDB drafts cleared on sign-out and encrypted with a WebCrypto session key.
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win. Frontend pairing per doc06 S1 Platform/Security track.

Title: Make payments atomic and derive invoice status from the sum of payments
What & why: Recording a payment is a lost-update read-modify-write with no overpayment check, and an interim-paid invoice stays "paid" after new charges.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Concurrent payments always satisfy paid = SUM(payments); overpayment rejected; status recomputed on every total change; QA-10 two-checkpoint test (J11) green.

Title: Add an Idempotency-Key filter and table for retried POSTs
What & why: Retried POSTs (Wi-Fi drops) can double-charge or double-register. Store keys with the original response and replay it.
Source refs: MF-26 (ARCH-25); EP02 | Src: ARCH-25, FE-11 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: idempotency_keys table + filter; same key returns the original response; payments, check-in, registration and booking covered; concurrent duplicate returns 409 or the original.

Title: Send Idempotency-Key from the client and recover failed payment submits
What & why: submitPayment has no catch, so a timeout plus retry can double-charge silently. The client must send a key and offer "check status" recovery.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Payments, check-in and registration send Idempotency-Key; a timed-out payment shows "check status" and never double-charges (E2E).

Title: Price invoice lines from the catalogue on the server and require authority for overrides
What & why: The client unit price or an arbitrary charge code can bypass discounts, and a later discount replaces an earlier one.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Server ignores client prices; overrides need billing.discount + reason; discounts are cumulative; QA-12 price-override authz test green; J9 price taken from catalogue.

Title: Use compare-and-set for queue status transitions
What & why: Queue transitions are validated then written without a status check, so concurrent edits bypass the workflow; completed bypasses checkout and no_show is allowed from in_consult.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: UPDATE ... WHERE status = :expected returns 409 on 0 rows; concurrent transition test green; only billing completes a visit; no_show not allowed from in_consult; CAS p95 < 200 ms.

Title: Add an "arrived" appointment status and block double check-in
What & why: The same appointment can be checked in twice, stays "scheduled" (so it can be cancelled mid-visit) and transfers leave it scheduled.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Two concurrent desks checking in one appointment produce exactly one 201 (CountDownLatch test); appointment shows "arrived" (J2); partial unique index on appointment_id; transfer marks the appointment; check-in p95 < 300 ms.

Title: Add an EXCLUDE constraint and schedule/leave validation to booking
What & why: The double-booking guard only catches identical start times; overlaps, leave, outside-hours, off-grid and past bookings are accepted and any constraint error maps to 409.
Source refs: MF-30; EP02; BQ-01 | Src: ARCH-06, QA-09 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: EXCLUDE USING gist (doctor_id WITH =, tstzrange WITH &&) in place; concurrent overlapping bookings: exactly one succeeds; leave/hours/off-grid/past rejected via ScheduleGrid (J3); constraint names mapped to specific errors; booking write p95 < 400 ms.

Title: Map all exceptions to Problem+JSON and clamp list page sizes
What & why: Only two exception types are handled: a missing claim gives 500, limit=0/-5 gives 500, limit=1000000 dumps every patient, and 59 list endpoints are unbounded.
Source refs: MF-38; Quick win #15 | Src: ARCH-23, ARCH-24, QA-19, QA-42 | doc06 §6.3
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: spring.mvc.problemdetails enabled with catch-all; limit=0 returns 400; shared PageRequest @Min(1) @Max(100); default limits on all lists; Schemathesis not_a_server_error smoke on list endpoints green.
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Repair "last visit" dates corrupted by migration backfills
What & why: Backfills rewrote updated_at, so "last visit" shows the migration date for older patients.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Last visit derived from queue_date/stage timestamps; one-off repair run; future backfills suppress update triggers (playbook rule).

Title: Add actuator, metrics and tracing, run as non-root and move migrations to a separate job
What & why: There is no health, metrics or tracing, the container runs as root without JVM container flags, and migrations run at app boot.
Source refs: MF-34; EP03; ADR-14; Quick win #14 | Src: ARCH-14, ARCH-27 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Actuator readiness/liveness; Micrometer Prometheus metrics (HTTP RED, Hikari, outbox lag); OTel traces; USER 10001; MaxRAMPercentage; layered jar; server.shutdown=graceful; Flyway runs as a separate pre-rollout job.
Notes: Includes a doc06 quick win.

Title: Run two replicas behind a load balancer in staging-in
What & why: Phase 0 exit requires two replicas passing the suite. Needs the persisted JWT key and health checks.
Source refs: MF-13; MF-34; EP03; ADR-15 | Src: ARCH-03, SEC-26, QA-37, ARCH-14, ARCH-27 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Two replicas behind an LB with readiness checks; full suite and prod-config job pass against them; rolling restart logs nobody out.

Title: Enable RLS with per-command WITH CHECK policies on the remaining tenant tables
What & why: login_attempts, workflow_definitions, package_eligible_doctors and owner/brand/tax tables have no RLS, and some policies are USING-only.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Schema test: every table with tenant_id has RLS enabled and forced with per-command policies including WITH CHECK (or is moved to master).

Title: Build the patient_registry_summary read model and its projector
What & why: The registry caps at 3,000 rows (patients after about "M" are invisible), runs an O(N^2) duplicate check and filters in memory at 24.9 s per 100 rows. Step 1: schema and projector.
Source refs: MF-07 (start); EP17 | Src: DP-03, ARCH-13 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: patient_registry_summary table populated by a projector and backfilled for all tenants; kept in sync on patient/visit changes (test).

Title: Create the packages/api-client skeleton and use it in checkout, check-in and registration
What & why: There is no shared API client (32 API_BASE copies, ~20 authedFetch copies, 6 fetch styles). Start the generated client with single-flight refresh, Problem parsing and automatic Idempotency-Key.
Source refs: MF-55 (start); EP04; ADR-06 | Src: FE-07, FE-10, FE-31, DP-26 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: packages/api-client exists with refresh, Problem+JSON, Idempotency-Key and AbortSignal; checkout, check-in and registration use it; 0 hand-written API types in touched pages.

Title: Bootstrap the OpenAPI spec from code and run oasdiff in report mode
What & why: 118-139 operations are undocumented and 5-6 spec paths are phantom; hand-written FE types drift. Generate the spec with springdoc, review it and commit it.
Source refs: MF-37 (start); EP03; ADR-10 | Src: ARCH-12, QA-35, FE-14, SEC-24 | doc06 §6.3 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: api/openapi/core.yaml generated and reviewed; phantom operations removed; oasdiff runs on every PR in report mode.

Title: Write concurrency suite v1 (check-in, booking, payment, status transitions)
What & why: Almost no concurrency or multi-actor tests exist. Build the CountDownLatch suites that verify the Sprint 1 integrity fixes.
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Double check-in => exactly one 201; concurrent payments keep paid = SUM; overlapping bookings => one success; concurrent status transitions => one success; runs in stage 3.

Title: Add a JaCoCo coverage baseline to CI
What & why: There is no coverage measurement. Baseline now; gates come later (backend >= 75%, safety/billing >= 90% line).
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: JaCoCo report published per PR; baseline recorded; new-code >= 80% reported.

Title: Apply consent, verification and own-patients gates to clinical reads
What & why: /v1/clinical/** reads ignore consent withdrawal, patient verification and own-patients scope, and field grants are applied in one place only.
Source refs: MF-17 (SQL gates); EP02; CI-05 | Src: SEC-06, SEC-25 | doc06 §6.4 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Clinical reads of a consent-withdrawn patient return 404; unverified patient and non-own-patient doctor cases covered by per-controller read-scope tests; field_grants applied on every clinical read.

Title: Record every PHI read in a partitioned phi_read_log
What & why: PHI reads are not audited, which blocks DPDP, CERT-In and any "who accessed my record" view. Write a separate append-only, batch-sealed read log.
Source refs: MF-18; EP31 groundwork; doc06 D8 | Src: SEC-09 | doc06 §6.4 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: PhiReadAuditTest: every clinical GET writes one phi_read_log row; partitioned monthly, append-only, sealed asynchronously in batches; read-volume alert configured; 13-month online retention pending DPO confirmation.

Title: Clamp and audit operator audit-console searches and narrow support grants
What & why: The operator audit console reads before/after values across tenants, uncapped and unaudited.
Source refs: MF-19 (clamp/audit part) | Src: SEC-14, SEC-20, SEC-37 | doc06 §6.4
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Audit search page size clamped; every operator search written to the audit log; support-access grant narrowed to named tenant and scope.

Title: Add key versioning and AAD to field encryption, with a re-encrypt job
What & why: One global AES key with no key version and no associated data protects all tenants and regions.
Source refs: MF-20 (S2 part); EP31 | Src: SEC-11, ARCH-36 | doc06 §6.4 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Ciphertexts carry a key-version prefix and AAD = tenant:row; re-encrypt job migrates existing rows; decrypt fails if AAD mismatches (test).

Title: Force MFA for owners, money-approval roles and operators
What & why: MFA is optional for Owner, refund/discount/approve roles, operators (incl. super_admin) and owner accounts.
Source refs: MF-12; EP01; PS-04 | Src: SEC-10 | doc06 §6.4 | doc05 §6
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Login for any of these identities without enrolled MFA is forced into enrolment; test per identity type; no config flag can disable it in prod.

Title: Limit OTP requests per phone number
What & why: OTP requests are not limited per number, enabling paid-message pumping and account enumeration.
Source refs: MF-24 (S2 part) | Src: SEC-18, ARCH-38 | doc06 §6.4
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Per-number OTP counter (Postgres) enforced; responses are a silent 202 whether or not the number exists; pumping test blocked.

Title: Rebuild the audit hash chain with a chain-head table, UTC hashing and nightly verify
What & why: The audit chain forks under concurrency, depends on RLS, hashes timezone-dependent text, serialises tenant writes and is never verified.
Source refs: MF-31; PS-03 | Src: ARCH-07, DP-05, SEC-27 | doc06 §6.4
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: audit_chain_heads updated via UPDATE ... RETURNING; UTC epoch in hash; verify_audit_chain true after 50 parallel writes (concurrency test); nightly verify job + off-box checkpoint; failures alert as security incident.

Title: Move external I/O out of database transactions and add a "no transaction open" guard
What & why: WhatsApp, SMTP and provisioning calls run inside open transactions with a small pool, so one slow provider can exhaust connections.
Source refs: MF-32; ADR-02 (runtime guard) | Src: ARCH-10, DP-06, DP-09 | doc06 §6.4
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Intent -> commit -> call -> record pattern; OTP sent via outbox; HTTP client asserts no open transaction; slow-provider test with a 10 s stub does not exhaust the pool.

Title: Add lease fencing, retention and metrics to the outbox
What & why: Outbox markDone/markFailed have no lease fencing and a batch can outlive its lease, causing duplicate sends; there is no retention or metrics.
Source refs: MF-33 (S2 part); ADR-03 | Src: ARCH-15, ARCH-33, DP-07, QA-29 | doc06 §6.4
Acceptance criteria / Definition of done: Fencing (AND status=processing AND attempts=:claimed); chaos test with two instances (QA-29) shows 0 duplicates; done rows purged after 7 days, dead after 90; pending/dead/age metrics exported.

Title: Block OTC sale of Rx-only items without a linked signed prescription
What & why: is_rx items can be sold over the counter without a signed Rx, which is a compliance and safety breach.
